verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
Lord who am I that I may be Your servant
Lord how can I do what You`ve called me to do
So make me strong and mighty for You Lord
So that I may serve You more

verse.name: b1a
verse.lines:
For You are the One I love
(For You are the One I love)
Whenever I fall You lift me high above

verse.name: b1b
verse.lines:
Make me see, let me feel
Your love, Your grace over me
Renew my life, open my eyes
So that I may do Your will

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Lord who am I that I may see your goodness
Lord how can I be what You`ve called me to be
So make me strong and mighty for You Lord
So that I may serve You more
